nodes.Name: endsWithCSSKeyword
nodes.DocComment:
endsWithCSSKeyword reports whether b ends with an ident that
case-insensitively matches the lower-case kw.

nodes.Name: isCSSNmchar
nodes.DocComment: isCSSNmchar reports whether rune is allowed anywhere in a CSS identifier.

nodes.Name: decodeCSS
nodes.DocComment:
decodeCSS decodes CSS3 escapes given a sequence of stringchars.
If there is no change, it returns the input, otherwise it returns a slice
backed by a new array.
https://www.w3.org/TR/css3-syntax/#SUBTOK-stringchar defines stringchar.

nodes.Name: isHex
nodes.DocComment: isHex reports whether the given character is a hex digit.

nodes.Name: hexDecode
nodes.DocComment: hexDecode decodes a short hex digit sequence: "10" -> 16.

nodes.Name: skipCSSSpace
nodes.DocComment: skipCSSSpace returns a suffix of c, skipping over a single space.

nodes.Name: isCSSSpace
nodes.DocComment: isCSSSpace reports whether b is a CSS space char as defined in wc.

nodes.Name: cssEscaper
nodes.DocComment: cssEscaper escapes HTML and CSS special characters using \<hex>+ escapes.

nodes.Name: cssValueFilter
nodes.DocComment:
cssValueFilter allows innocuous CSS values in the output including CSS
quantities (10px or 25%), ID or class literals (#foo, .bar), keyword values
(inherit, blue), and colors (#888).
It filters out unsafe values, such as those that affect token boundaries,
and anything that might execute scripts.
